step1.title: Welcome to Forever
step1.desc: Your shared digital sanctuary — everything here belongs only to the two of you.

step2.title: Your Feature Modules
step2.desc: Each card leads to a different way to connect and grow together. Tap any to explore.

step3.title: Quick Actions
step3.desc: Use Heartbeat for a quick 'thinking of you', and Whisper for deeper emotional conversations.

step1.title: Your Story
step1.desc: This is your shared memory timeline — every chapter of your relationship preserved here forever.

step2.title: Add a Memory
step2.desc: Tap the Add button to record a new memory. Give it a date, a title, and your words.

step3.title: Browse Your Past
step3.desc: Scroll through your timeline. Filter by year, place, or type to relive the moments that matter.

step1.title: Shared Dreams
step1.desc: Your bucket list — all the adventures and experiences you want to have together.

step2.title: Add a Dream
step2.desc: Tap the Add button and choose a category: Travel, Experience, Home, or Other.

step3.title: Mark it Done
step3.desc: Completed a dream? Check it off and earn a gold seal. You can link it to a memory too.

step4.title: Drag to Reorder
step4.desc: Press and hold any item to drag it into a new position on your list.

step1.title: Today's Question
step1.desc: A new thought-provoking question appears every day — the same one for both of you.

step2.title: Answer in Secret
step2.desc: Write your answer privately. Neither of you sees the other's answer until you've both replied.

step3.title: The Reveal
step3.desc: Once both answers are in, they appear side by side. See how alike — or beautifully different — you are.

step1.title: Letters in Time
step1.desc: Write a message that can only be opened on a future date you choose.

step2.title: End-to-End Encrypted
step2.desc: Your capsule is locked with your shared passphrase. The server never sees the decrypted text.

step3.title: Open When Ready
step3.desc: On the unlock date, enter your passphrase to reveal the letter. A gift from your past selves.

step1.title: Your Mood, Shared
step1.desc: Tell your partner how you're feeling right now without needing words.

step2.title: Pick a Mood
step2.desc: Choose from six moods, set your energy level, and add what you need right now.

step3.title: Live Updates
step3.desc: Your partner's vibe updates in real time. No refresh needed — just glance and know.

step1.title: Your Places
step1.desc: Every meaningful location in your story — pinned on an interactive map.

step2.title: Add a Pin
step2.desc: Long-press anywhere on the map to drop a pin. Tag it as visited, a dream, a first date, or home.

step3.title: Tap a Pin
step3.desc: Tap any pin to see its details and the memory you've linked to it.

step1.title: Star Map of Memories
step1.desc: Every memory in your timeline becomes a star in your personal constellation.

step2.title: Golden Spiral
step2.desc: Stars are placed along a golden ratio spiral — the most beautiful arrangement in nature.

step3.title: Tap a Star
step3.desc: Tap any star to see the memory it represents. Pinch to zoom, drag to pan.

step1.title: A Safe Space to Speak
step1.desc: Whisper is for the things that are hard to say. Write from your heart, without blame.

step2.title: The AI Softener
step2.desc: Tap 'Soften this' to let Claude AI reframe your words into 'I feel…' language — kinder and clearer.

step3.title: 30-Minute Pause
step3.desc: Your whisper arrives 30 minutes later. A built-in cooling-off period before it's sent.

step4.title: Your Partner Responds
step4.desc: They can reply: 'I hear you', 'Tell me more', or 'Let's talk'. Simple, but powerful.

step1.title: See Through Their Eyes
step1.desc: A new reflective question every Monday — designed to help you understand each other more deeply.

step2.title: Answer Privately
step2.desc: Both of you answer in secret. Neither sees the other's words until you've both submitted.

step3.title: The Reveal
step3.desc: Answers appear side by side with a golden reveal animation. A window into each other's inner world.

step1.title: Commitments That Count
step1.desc: Add promises you make to each other — daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

step2.title: Check In
step2.desc: Each cycle a gentle question appears: 'Did you keep your promise today?' No judgment, only awareness.

step3.title: Gold Seal of Honor
step3.desc: Tap yes and earn a gold seal. The ledger tracks your streak — a beautiful record of integrity.

step1.title: On This Day
step1.desc: Echo surfaces anything from your timeline that happened on today's date in past years.

step2.title: Memories, Gratitudes & More
step2.desc: It searches across memories, gratitudes, and other entries — a surprise from your past selves.

step3.title: Relive It
step3.desc: Tap any entry to see the full moment. Let the past speak to your present.

step1.title: One Tap, One Message
step1.desc: The Heartbeat button says everything with nothing: 'I'm thinking of you right now.'

step2.title: Send a Pulse
step2.desc: Tap the gold button to send a heartbeat. Your partner sees it and feels it.

step3.title: Daily Rhythm
step3.desc: Your heartbeat count resets every day. A gentle ritual to stay connected across any distance.

step1.title: The Gratitude Trail
step1.desc: A flowing stream of small thankful moments — the things that make your relationship beautiful.

step2.title: Add Gratitude
step2.desc: Tap the field and complete: 'I am grateful for…' Then save it to your shared trail.

step3.title: A Growing River
step3.desc: Every entry adds to a living, scrollable record. When you're having a hard day, read through it.

step1.title: Know Each Other Deeply
step1.desc: The Blueprint is your partner manual — the details that eliminate guesswork forever.

step2.title: Four Categories
step2.desc: Sizes & measurements, favorites & tastes, essentials & allergies, and family dates. Fill yours in.

step3.title: See Both Profiles
step3.desc: Your data and your partner's appear side by side — clearly labeled so you always know whose is whose.

step1.title: Secret Romantic Missions
step1.desc: Get assigned a small, meaningful romantic act at random. Simple gestures, big impact.

step2.title: 48-Hour Window
step2.desc: Complete your mission within 48 hours. Tap 'Mission Complete' when you've done it.

step3.title: Partner Confirms
step3.desc: Your partner gets to confirm it happened. Their 'Yes!' earns you a gold seal of love.

step1.title: The Safe Harbor
step1.desc: When conflict arises, open the Truce. It's a structured pause before the storm escalates.

step2.title: 20-Minute Timer
step2.desc: The interface shifts to calm blue. A 20-minute countdown gives both of you space to breathe.

step3.title: Share How You Feel
step3.desc: After the timer, write 'I feel…' in your own words. Then read each other's — and begin again, gently.

step1.title: No More 'Where Should We Eat?'
step1.desc: Add your restaurant options and swipe independently. A match means you both want it.

step2.title: Add Options
step2.desc: Tap Add to put restaurants or home-cooked meals on the list. Anyone can add anytime.

step3.title: Swipe & Match
step3.desc: Swipe right for yes, left for no. When you both swipe yes on the same option — celebration!

step1.title: Draw Together
step1.desc: A shared canvas where you leave visual messages for each other — no words needed.

step2.title: Pick a Color
step2.desc: Choose from 7 colors including the signature gold. Draw anything you feel.

step3.title: Find Their Art
step3.desc: When your partner opens the canvas, they'll see what you drew. A silent, beautiful surprise.

step1.title: Everything You'll Do Together
step1.desc: Movies, shows, books, and places — all in one shared list, waiting for your next date.

step2.title: Add to the Queue
step2.desc: Tap Add, pick a category, and add a title with an optional link. Both of you can add anytime.

step3.title: Check It Off
step3.desc: Watched it? Read it? Tap the checkmark. It moves to Completed with a gold seal and the date.

step1.title: Your Voice, Preserved
step1.desc: Record voice messages up to 60 seconds. Your actual voice, saved in your sanctuary forever.

step2.title: Press & Hold to Record
step2.desc: Hold the microphone button to record. Release to send. Your partner sees a golden waveform.

step3.title: Unheard Messages Glow
step3.desc: New voice notes you haven't listened to yet have a gold border — so nothing gets missed.

step1.title: Magic Link Sign-In
step1.desc: No password to remember. Enter your email and we'll send you a secure login link.

step2.title: Check Your Inbox
step2.desc: Click the link in your email and you'll be brought straight into Forever — securely.

step1.title: Create Your Sanctuary
step1.desc: You're the one setting up your shared space. Fill in your name and your partner's email.

step2.title: Set the Wedding Date
step2.desc: Optional but beautiful — we'll build a live countdown to your wedding day on the dashboard.

step3.title: The Secret Passphrase
step3.desc: Choose a phrase only the two of you know. It's used to encrypt your Time Capsule letters — never stored.

step1.title: Admin Dashboard
step1.desc: From here you can see all couples who have registered and those awaiting review.

step2.title: Review Couples
step2.desc: Go to the Couples page to approve or decline each couple's application to join Forever.

step3.title: Bless or Decline
step3.desc: Tap Bless to approve a couple — they'll be notified and their sanctuary will be activated.

step1.title: Every Couple, One Place
step1.desc: Each card is a couple awaiting review. Filter by state to focus on the queue that matters right now.

step2.title: Open a Profile
step2.desc: Tap any couple to see their names, contact email, and wedding date in the side panel.

step3.title: Bless or Decline
step3.desc: Bless activates their sanctuary; Decline lets you leave a private note explaining why.

step1.title: Your Account
step1.desc: This is your shared profile — names, wedding date, and the details that personalize Forever.

step2.title: Edit Names
step2.desc: Add both of you in Latin and Arabic script. We'll use the right one based on the active language.

step3.title: Save Your Changes
step3.desc: Tap Save when you're done. The dashboard countdown and greeting will update right away.

step1.title: Welcome to Forever
step1.desc: Your partner invited you to a private space. Just add your name to claim your half of the sanctuary.

step2.title: Both Scripts Welcome
step2.desc: Fill in Latin and Arabic — your name appears in whichever language you're using at the moment.

step3.title: Accept the Invitation
step3.desc: Tap Accept and we'll send your sanctuary off for a quick blessing from the Forever team.

step1.title: Almost There
step1.desc: You're paired with your partner. We just need a moment to approve your sanctuary.

step2.title: Submit for Review
step2.desc: If both of you have joined, tap Submit for Review to let the Forever team take a look.

step3.title: We'll Notify You
step3.desc: Once you're blessed, the sanctuary unlocks instantly — no refresh needed.

step1.title: Application Declined
step1.desc: Your couple application wasn't accepted this time. Reach out if you'd like to know more.

step2.title: Back to Sign-In
step2.desc: You can return to the sign-in screen and try again or reach out to the Forever team.
